subject: Coordinating multi-prospect inference showcase — propose time grid & agenda
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Porter <alyssa@nimbleai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@dataforge.ai>, Camille Roy <camille@edgeplatform.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating multi-prospect inference showcase — propose time grid & agenda

Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to a joint technical showcase where we'll walk through Redwood's hosting/dedicated/private inference options and do a short Q&A on integration patterns (KV cache, batching strategies, and rollout safety). I pulled together a short agenda and a time-grid with candidate windows across PT/ET/CET — attached.

Quick asks to help us lock this:
- Please indicate (reply) which of the 3 candidate windows below works best for your team and who will attend. If none work, tell me two preferred options and your timezone.
- If you have any must-see areas (e.g., quantization, privacy/KMS), flag them so we can route to the right engineer.

Candidate windows (all on Tue May 11):
1) 9:00–9:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET / 18:00–18:45 CET
2) 11:30–12:15 PT / 14:30–15:15 ET / 20:30–21:15 CET
3) 15:00–15:45 PT / 18:00–18:45 ET / 00:00–00:45 CET (late EMEA-friendly)

Attached: agenda-inference-demo.pdf (short agenda) and timezone-grid.ics (one-click to add proposed slots).

Marissa & Ben — we expect ~3–4 external engineers and 2 product folks across these accounts. Can you take lead on presenters and whether we want a separate breakout room for integration Q&A?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda-inference-demo.pdf (PDF, 14KB)]
[Attachment: timezone-grid.ics (iCalendar, 2KB)]

Thanks Jordan — Alyssa here. The team at NimbleAI would prefer option 1 (early slot) or, if that's tight, option 2. We'll have 2 IC engineers (me + Diego) and our ML infra lead (Priya). Must-see for us: latency/throughput tradeoffs and how prefix caching behaves for short-turn dialogs.

If possible, can we keep the session to 40 minutes and save 15 for a tech breakout? I can join breakout with Diego.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Porter | Head of ML, NimbleAI
[Note: add Diego Fernandez <diego@nimbleai.com> if you finalize invite]

We should plan for option 2 (11:30 PT) as the consensus, but keep option 1 as backup in case legal/procurement from any account needs an earlier sync. I'll prepare a 12-min architecture deck and an integration checklist to drop in the chat.

Marissa
